title: Live-readiness matrix for in-play feature families
central_timestamp_fact: All local artifacts are post-hoc, complete-match; the only time coordinate is the match-clock minute (enables offline point-in-time REPLAY). No source carries a wall-clock event PUBLICATION timestamp, so offline-replayable != live-eligible.

families.source_timestamp_semantics: match-clock minute only (elapsed); NO wall-clock event publication timestamp on StatsBomb-open / API-Football historical
families.required_provider_fields: live score, elapsed minute, red-card count, sub count per team
families.evidence_needed_before_live: measure API-Football live goal/card publication latency on >=20 live matches; confirm monotonic clock; verify regulation/ET split live
families.notes: lowest-barrier family; score+time+players already drive the only validated in-play gains

families.source_timestamp_semantics: deterministic from kickoff + elapsed; no external publish lag
families.required_provider_fields: authoritative elapsed minute + period
families.evidence_needed_before_live: verify provider clock matches official; handle stoppage-time semantics live
families.notes: purely derived; only risk is clock source disagreement live

families.source_timestamp_semantics: post-hoc model output; xG attached AFTER full match processing; no live publish time
families.required_provider_fields: per-shot xG with shot match-minute, delivered intra-match
families.evidence_needed_before_live: a LIVE xG provider contract (StatsBomb/Opta live xG) with measured per-shot delivery latency; StatsBomb-open is post-hoc & non-commercial -> not live-usable
families.notes: research result: in-play xG did NOT beat score+Elo; low priority to make live

families.source_timestamp_semantics: derived from post-hoc xG stream; inherits no-publish-time
families.required_provider_fields: low-latency per-shot xG to compute trailing windows live
families.evidence_needed_before_live: same live-xG contract as cumulative_xg; plus stability test of windowed derivatives under live revision (xG values can be revised post-match)
families.notes: depends entirely on a live xG feed; revisions are a schema/latency risk

families.primary_source: API-Football team-level shots + StatsBomb shot events
families.source_timestamp_semantics: post-hoc team stats; API-Football live shot stats lag final reconciliation
families.required_provider_fields: live team shot / shot-on-target counters
families.evidence_needed_before_live: measure API-Football live shot-stat latency & revision rate; team-stat counters are known to be revised during/after matches
families.notes: counts (not locations) are obtainable; latency+revision are the open question

families.source_timestamp_semantics: post-hoc spatial data; no live publication; API-Football has NO xy
families.required_provider_fields: live shot x,y coordinates
families.evidence_needed_before_live: a provider that delivers live shot xy (Opta/StatsBomb live); API-Football verified to LACK shot locations entirely
families.notes: hard-blocked for live without a new spatial provider; offline replay fine

families.source_timestamp_semantics: post-hoc xG threshold; not a provider 'big chance' flag
families.required_provider_fields: live xG per shot (to threshold) or provider big-chance flag
families.evidence_needed_before_live: live xG feed OR a provider-native big-chance event with measured latency
families.notes: proxy is fine offline; live needs the same xG dependency

families.source_timestamp_semantics: post-hoc; live possession % is a smoothed running stat with provider lag
families.required_provider_fields: live possession share / passes
families.evidence_needed_before_live: measure live possession-stat latency & smoothing; confirm definition parity with the offline event-derived metric
families.notes: definition mismatch (event-derived vs provider-smoothed) is a schema risk

families.source_timestamp_semantics: post-hoc spatial aggregation; no live publish time
families.required_provider_fields: live event locations (passes/touches by third)
families.evidence_needed_before_live: a live event-location feed; API-Football lacks granular locations -> needs spatial provider
families.notes: offline replay solid; live needs granular location stream

families.source_timestamp_semantics: post-hoc location-derived count; no live publish time
families.required_provider_fields: live entries-into-box events or locations
families.evidence_needed_before_live: live location/event feed defining box entries; verify definition parity
families.notes: location-dependent -> same spatial-provider gap as field tilt

families.source_timestamp_semantics: post-hoc possession-chain reconstruction; no live publish time
families.required_provider_fields: live ordered event stream sufficient to rebuild possession chains
families.evidence_needed_before_live: live full event stream + chain reconstruction validated against offline chains live
families.notes: most data-hungry families; chain logic is offline-validated only

families.source_timestamp_semantics: post-hoc; no live publish time
families.required_provider_fields: live possession-change events
families.evidence_needed_before_live: live event stream with possession ownership; confirm recovery/turnover definitions
families.notes: definition-heavy; offline-only until live event stream verified

families.source_timestamp_semantics: post-hoc; pressure is a StatsBomb-specific event type, not in API-Football
families.required_provider_fields: live pressure events (StatsBomb-style) or accepted proxy
families.evidence_needed_before_live: a provider that emits pressure-type events live; API-Football does not have them
families.notes: provider-specific event type -> contract-blocked for live

families.source_timestamp_semantics: post-hoc counts; corners/FK are discrete, low-latency in most live feeds
families.required_provider_fields: live corner / free-kick counters
families.evidence_needed_before_live: measure live set-piece event latency; these are usually reliable live signals
families.notes: relatively live-friendly (discrete events); latency just needs measuring

families.source_timestamp_semantics: discrete events with on-field minute; API-Football delivers live but lag unmeasured
families.required_provider_fields: live yellow/red events with minute + player id
families.evidence_needed_before_live: measure live card publication latency; reconcile 2nd-yellow vs straight-red live
families.notes: high-value low-volume signal; API-Football coverage already verified historically

families.source_timestamp_semantics: discrete events; live publish lag unmeasured
families.required_provider_fields: live substitution events with minute + in/out player ids
families.evidence_needed_before_live: measure live sub publication latency; subs sometimes published late vs broadcast
families.notes: available historically; subs feed quality is the live unknown

families.source_timestamp_semantics: published ~T-60min pre-kickoff; effectively point-in-time for pre-match
families.required_provider_fields: confirmed XI + formation at publication time
families.required_max_latency: <=publish at T-60; <=60s for in-play role changes
families.evidence_needed_before_live: verify live lineup publish time vs kickoff; player plane was an honest NEGATIVE so low ROI
families.notes: best-covered family; but research showed no pre-match 1X2 gain over Elo

families.catalog_link: MEMORY player_plane: key-availability feature (neutral vs Elo)
families.source_timestamp_semantics: derived from lineups (pre-match point-in-time)
families.required_provider_fields: confirmed XI + a player-importance prior computed from strictly-prior matches
families.evidence_needed_before_live: leakage-safe player-importance prior; research showed neutral/negative vs Elo
families.notes: feasible live but unproven value; deprioritized by prior nulls

families.primary_source: venues_2026.csv + external weather (not in local validated set)
families.source_timestamp_semantics: venue static; weather forecast point-in-time; travel/rest deterministic from schedule
families.required_provider_fields: as-of weather forecast + confirmed venue + fixture schedule
families.evidence_needed_before_live: a point-in-time weather history/forecast source with as-of timestamps; only venue+schedule are locally validated (weather history is NOT in the local validated artifacts)
families.notes: venue/travel deterministic; weather needs an as-of-timestamped source not yet on disk

families.source_timestamp_semantics: pre-match snapshot_time<=kickoff; in-play odds NOT in local validated artifacts
families.required_provider_fields: in-play odds stream with snapshot timestamps
families.evidence_needed_before_live: an in-play odds feed with per-snapshot timestamps; only pre-match odds exist locally, so in-play market features have NO point-in-time history to backtest
families.notes: market is research-relevant but there is zero local in-play-odds history to validate

families.primary_source: StatsBomb/API-Football historical aggregated to strictly-prior matches
families.source_timestamp_semantics: as-of kickoff date (strictly earlier matches only); inherently point-in-time
families.required_provider_fields: rolling prior built from completed prior matches only
families.evidence_needed_before_live: none beyond keeping the strictly-prior ordering; already leakage-safe and replayable
families.notes: the most live-ready conceptually (pre-match, as-of), but depends on the upstream event feeds it aggregates
